avis.titre: This eye cream has noticeable effects
avis.texte: I have been using this for years cream for about a week and I'm already seeing results under and around my eye area. I'm in my early forties and really starting to see signs of aging and I was very very happy to have that week rested look with zero puffiness. My under eyes look hydrated and fine lines appear blurred. It absorbs very well and can be used for day or night. I will definitely recommend it's a great product.

This stri vectin super C eye cream is great! It goes on easy without a scent. It helped my eyes feel and look refreshed and the skin felt tight. I can't wait to keep using this to see long term effects!

avis.titre: Safe for sensitive skin but can sting at first
avis.texte: The StriVectin Super-C Eye Vitamin C Eye Cream is a rich, thick cream that leaves your under eyes looking dewy and recharged. It has a faint, clean scent. I have been using it for nearly a week and can see a difference. My under eyes look brighter and more dewy which helps to diminish the appearance of my dark circles. I apply a small amount of the cream on clean skin in the a.m. and p.m., as directed. The cream can sometimes sting when I first apply it to my under eye area, and there is some redness. The redness fades into a glow within a half hour of application. My skin is very sensitive so I am happy I can tolerate this cream! I will be adding this to my skin care routine.

Super rich eye cream. Absorbs quickly and left my under eyes feeling soft and hydrated. The packaging is a neon orange and very pretty. Very light scent from the vitamin C but did not irritate my eyes or skin
The packaging is really pretty. It is unscented which I really appreciate and the consistency is very thick almost too thick, but I think I like it!!
